QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_12

question.text: Under the Compliance Test Report (CTR) framework, the Investment Manager must submit the CTR to the Sponsor/Trustee within:

answer.text: 30 days of the end of the financial year
45 days of the end of the financial year
60 days of the end of the financial year
90 days of the end of the financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: The CTR must be prepared and submitted by the Investment Manager within 30 days of the end of the financial year to the Sponsor/Trustee. Sponsor/Trustee respond within a further 30 days; the Manager then incorporates changes within 15 days. The Trap: 45/60/90 days are generic audit-style windows but the CTR regulation is a strict 30-day window from FYE. Note: The workbook sets the 30/30/15 CTR timeline; specific month-by-month operational scheduling is not part of the syllabus.
